g.title: Nitration of benzene event 1
g.desc: HNO₃ + H₂SO₄ ⇌ H₂NO₃⁺ + HSO₄⁻ Nitric acid hydroxyl O → sulfuric acid H; acid O–H pair → acid O. Formal N+/O− charges preserve octets.

g.text: Nitric acid hydroxyl O → sulfuric acid H; acid O–H pair → acid O. Formal N+/O− charges preserve octets.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Nitration of benzene event 2
g.desc: H₂NO₃⁺ → NO₂⁺ + H₂O N–OH2 bond pair → leaving water O; remaining O− lone pair → N=O. Linear nitronium results.

g.text: N–OH2 bond pair → leaving water O; remaining O− lone pair → N=O. Linear nitronium results.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Nitration of benzene event 3
g.desc: C₆H₆ + NO₂⁺ → [C₆H₆NO₂]⁺ Benzene pi pair → nitronium N; N=O pi pair → O (N octet). One arenium contributor, not a localized unique ion.

g.text: Benzene pi pair → nitronium N; N=O pi pair → O (N octet). One arenium contributor, not a localized unique ion.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Nitration of benzene event 4
g.desc: [C₆H₆NO₂]⁺ + HSO₄⁻ → C₆H₅NO₂ + H₂SO₄ Bisulfate O → substituted ring H; C–H pair → adjacent C=C. Aromaticity and sulfuric acid are restored.

g.text: Bisulfate O → substituted ring H; C–H pair → adjacent C=C. Aromaticity and sulfuric acid are restored.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.
